name: senior-dev-kit
description: Agents, skills, rules and guardrails that make Claude Code behave like a senior engineering team. Installed as a Claude Code plugin or into ~/.claude.

seniorDevKit.//: Single source of truth for the Node floor `scripts/install.mjs` must run on. It is deliberately lower than engines.node: engines covers the TypeScript validators a contributor runs, the installer runs on whatever Node a new user already has. Both READMEs' stated floor, lib/install-core.mjs's header note, and the installer-compat CI job are checked against this value by scripts/check-consistency.ts.
seniorDevKit.//siteOrigin: Public origin of the landing page. Single source of truth for the canonical and hreflang URLs gen-site.ts writes into site/dist/, AND for the CNAME file it emits onto the gh-pages branch — the two cannot disagree because one produces the other. Set it to the GitHub Pages default (https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>) if the custom domain is ever dropped; gen-site.ts then emits no CNAME.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/validate-skills.test.ts scripts/deny-cost.test.ts scripts/run-checks.test.ts scripts/behavior-eval.test.ts scripts/rule-globs.test.ts scripts/templates.test.ts scripts/install.test.mjs scripts/session-context.test.mjs
